text:
marta: Heads-up — saw a weird eviction feedback loop on prod-slice-3 during the extended chat benchmark at ~11:20 UTC. KV residency for one tenant jumped from ~60% -> ~92% over ~12 minutes and kept stealing pages from neighbors, causing cascading cold starts.

lee: logs?

marta: pasted the quick logs we pulled:
```
2026-03-15T11:20:03Z eviction: tenant=acme-42 pages=128 reclaimed=0 frag=0.62
2026-03-15T11:25:11Z eviction: tenant=acme-42 pages=1024 reclaimed=12 frag=0.79
2026-03-15T11:32:02Z eviction: tenant=acme-42 pages=2048 reclaimed=5 frag=0.84
```
Looks like fragmentation and allocation churn increases with longctx traffic; reclaim rate falls while residency grows.

sasha: interesting. Could kernel selection/batching heuristics be amplifying this? larger kernels -> bigger per-request KV footprint?

marta: yep — profiled a sample trace: long-seq callers triggered kernel variants that allocate more KV segments per token. At the same time batching grouped several of these, so concurrent live KV entries spiked.

jamie: that smells like a feedback loop: tenant grows KV -> evict others -> those others cold-start and re-request KV entries -> tenant requests more to keep state -> repeat.

ryan: mitigation ideas: soft per-tenant watermarks + "reclaim hold" (short grace where reclaimed pages are kept warm for reuse rather than immediate free). Also a background compaction sweep to defragment free lists.

marta: proposed experiment: (1) signal-only watermark at 70% residency per-tenant (alerts + slow-path routing), (2) implement 30s reclaim-hold where reclaimed pages are pushed to a warm pool for 30s before being fully free, (3) trigger compaction during low load windows. I'll own (1) and (2).

lee: add metrics before rollout: eviction_rate_by_tenant, frag_ratio_by_tenant, reclaimed_warm_hits. We'll need per-slice and global aggregation.

sasha: also run an AB: baseline slice vs reclaim-hold slice to isolate behavior. Keep kernel selection unchanged for now.

ops-bot: deploy started by marta for revset evict-hold-20260315 (https://ci/redwood/1234) :hammer_and_wrench:

jamie: if we still see runaway residency, escalate to enforced soft-quota + slow-down (throttle new KV allocations) for the noisy tenant.

marta: plan: canary tonight 00:00 UTC for 48h, dashboards up by 00:15. I'll post a quick summary at 12h and 48h. Thanks.

lee: :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks — important one to solve before longctx rolls out wider.
